instruction: How to clear a HAProxy stick-table
output: echo 'clear table web-backend' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to add HTTP basic auth to HAProxy stats
output: echo 'stats auth admin:password123' > /etc/haproxy/stats-auth.cfg

instruction: How to enable HAProxy stats page
output: echo 'listen stats :1936 mode http stats enable stats uri / stats auth admin:password123' >> /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg

instruction: How to add stick-table to HAProxy config for persistence
output: echo 'backend web-backend stick-table type ip size 1k expire 30m stick on src' >> /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg

instruction: How to show HAProxy stick-table contents
output: echo 'show table web-backend' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to show HAProxy errors via socket
output: echo 'show errors' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to show HAProxy stats via socket
output: echo 'show stat' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to show HAProxy build info
output: haproxy -vv

instruction: How to show HAProxy pools via socket
output: echo 'show pools' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to show HAProxy activity via socket
output: echo 'show activity' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to show HAProxy ACLs via socket
output: echo 'show acl' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to show all HAProxy frontends via socket
output: echo 'show frontend' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to configure HAProxy health check with custom interval
output: echo 'server web01 10.0.0.1:80 check inter 2s rise 3 fall 5' >> /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg

instruction: How to start HAProxy with a config file
output: haproxy -f /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg

instruction: How to set server to ready state in HAProxy
output: echo 'set server web-backend/web01 state ready' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to check HAProxy connection distribution
output: echo 'show stat | cut -d, -f1,2,6,7,18' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to test HAProxy configuration syntax
output: haproxy -f /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg -c

instruction: How to put server in maintenance mode in HAProxy
output: echo 'set server web-backend/web01 state maint' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to add HTTP request rewriting in HAProxy
output: echo 'http-request set-header X-Forwarded-Proto https if { ssl_fc }' >> /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg

instruction: How to set up HAProxy ACL for path-based routing
output: echo 'acl is_api path_beg -i /api use_backend api-backend if is_api default_backend web-backend' >> /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg
